$why: Moved out of spec-mode-runner.js deriveGuardVocabulary on 2026-08-15 (4 of 20).
The terms this returns feed a BM25/IDF ranker, so the prompt decides what the search
amplifies and what it demotes. It carries FOUR conditional sections — persona,
documentation, evidence and the CodeGraph verify block — each assembled by the caller and
arriving whole or empty. A template that branches is a program.
